# Execution History and Reliability

Covers dimensions 9 (Execution history and debugging) and 10 (Retry and error
handling). Sources referenced in [citations.md](../citations.md).

---

## Execution History (Dimension 9)

### Runs Dashboard

The Dashboard → Runs view shows all flow executions [12]:

| Feature | Details | Source |
|---------|---------|--------|
| Status per step | ✅ (success) or ❌ (failure) | [12] |
| View mode | Builder in read-only mode | [12] |
| Step inspection | Click step → Run Details panel (input + output) | [12] |
| Real-time updates | Step-by-step during test execution | [12] |

### Data Persistence

| Property | Value | Source |
|----------|-------|--------|
| Execution data retention | 30 days default (AP_EXECUTION_DATA_RETENTION_DAYS) | [11] |
| Failed job retention | 30 days (AP_REDIS_FAILED_JOB_RETENTION_DAYS) | [11] |
| Max failed jobs stored | 2,000 (AP_REDIS_FAILED_JOB_RETENTION_MAX_COUNT) | [11] |
| Audit log retention | 90 days default (AP_AUDIT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS) | Agent C discovery |
| Max flow run log size | 25 MB per run (AP_MAX_FLOW_RUN_LOG_SIZE_MB) | [11][13] |
| Storage backend | PostgreSQL (primary) | [4] |

Execution history is stored in PostgreSQL [4]. Scheduled cleanup removes logs
after the retention period (Agent C discovery).

### Data Masking

Credentials and sensitive information are "systematically censored within the
logs" [14], ensuring execution history does not expose secrets.

### Limitations

- **Search/filter:** Feature request exists for searching execution history
  (Agent C discovery). Current filtering capabilities not confirmed.
- **console.log:** Bug reported where console.log output missing from Code piece
  UI (Agent C discovery). Status unknown.
- **Log size cap:** Runs exceeding 25 MB log size are truncated or fail
  (behavior not documented) [13].

## Retry and Error Handling (Dimension 10)

### Auto-Retry

| Property | Value | Source |
|----------|-------|--------|
| Max retries | 4 attempts | [18] |
| Total retry window | ~4 minutes | [18] |
| Backoff strategy | Exponential (max 32 seconds per Agent C) | Agent C discovery |
| Configuration | Per-step, in action settings | [18] |

Auto-retry addresses "timeout and rate limiting errors" [18]. When both
auto-retry and Continue On Failure are enabled, all 4 retries execute before
the flow continues [18].

**Known issue:** The 32-second backoff maximum may be insufficient for APIs
with longer rate-limit windows (e.g., Google Sheets 1-minute intervals)
(Agent C discovery).

### Continue On Failure

When enabled per step, the flow continues execution even if the step fails [18].
The failed step is marked in the run history [18]. This must be configured
individually for each action step — no flow-level default exists [18].

### Flow-Level Error Handling

| Mechanism | Details | Source |
|-----------|---------|--------|
| Flow timeout | 600 seconds (10 minutes) | [11][13] |
| Paused flow timeout | 30 days (AP_PAUSED_FLOW_TIMEOUT_DAYS) | [11] |
| Trigger failure threshold | 576 consecutive failures before disable | [11] |

Paused flows (via Wait for Approval or Delay steps) do not count toward the
600-second timeout [13].

### Dead Letter Queue

No ActivePieces-specific dead letter queue implementation was found. The
underlying Redis/BullMQ infrastructure supports DLQ patterns, and failed job
retention is configurable [11], but there is no documented first-class DLQ
feature for permanently failed flows.

### Error Notifications

Discovery agents reported error notifications through logs, dashboard alerts,
and direct notifications, but the specific notification channels (email,
webhook, Slack) and their configuration were not confirmed from primary sources.

---

## Assessment for Personal Assistant Use Case

**Execution history: Meets requirements.** Per-step input/output inspection with
30-day retention covers debugging needs. Data masking protects credentials in
logs.

**Retry: Partially meets requirements.** Auto-retry with 4 attempts is
functional but limited — no configurable backoff timing, no configurable retry
count. For CLI tools that may have transient failures, 4 retries over 4 minutes
is reasonable but inflexible.

**Error handling gap:** No dead letter queue and no error notification hooks mean
permanently failed flows require manual monitoring via the Runs dashboard.

---

## Gaps and Limitations

- Execution history search/filter capabilities not confirmed
- console.log visibility bug status unknown
- Exact backoff timing between retries not documented
- Retry count not configurable (fixed at 4)
- No dead letter queue for permanently failed executions
- Error notification channels and configuration not documented
- Behavior when flow run log exceeds 25 MB not documented
